title: Repository Validation
purpose: Defines repository validation performed against the complete staged repository before promotion.

normative_requirements.text: The repository validation component shall validate the complete staged repository at `repository/` inside the staging transaction root, including its candidate document skeletons and empty product-specification workspace and local Git state, against declared conformance requirements, structural constraints, and repository-specification rules before promotion, using the checks declared in the validation profile (product.validation-profile) in profile order and producing a validation report conforming to the validation report spec (product.validation-report) with machine-readable failure codes from the defined enumeration; validation shall execute every check in the validation profile: request.schema (request JSON structure and field types), request.canonicalization (canonical form derivation), source.repository-local (source is a valid local Git repository), source.revision-commit (revision resolves to a valid commit), source.objects-complete (all required Git objects exist locally), material-manifest.schema (material manifest validates against its schema), material-manifest.paths (every selected source path in the manifest exists and has the expected source_type), output.inventory-complete (every output inventory entry with required true is present in the staged repository), output.no-undeclared-paths (no path exists in the staged repository that is not in the inventory), output.copied-bytes-match (every copied blob matches the source commit tree bytes), output.generated-records-valid (every generated record validates against its governing schema), output.direction-evidence-match (every direction evidence file is byte-identical to its declared source Git blob and manifest entries match), output.repository-digest-match (the repository-tree digest matches the expected digest), git.branch (initial branch matches bootstrap profile), git.root-commit-count (exactly one root commit), git.worktree-clean (worktree has no unstaged or untracked files), git.remote-count (no remotes configured; advisory), handoff.consistent (handoff manifest content matches staged repository state), provenance.consistent (authority.granted_by matches provenance record request identifier).

The repository validation component shall produce a validation report conforming to product.validation-report that lists each check in validation-profile order, its status (pass, fail, or error), failure code and message when applicable, and evidence fields, and shall not report overall success when any required check fails; the report shall be written at `transaction/validation-report.json` inside the staging transaction root and shall never be part of the promoted repository content.
